info.title: cslq - semantic C# queries over the official roslyn-language-server
info.description: Semantic C# queries over the official roslyn-language-server, for coding agents.

options.name: --sentinel
options.description: readiness probe symbol (default: inferred from the workspace)

options.name: --context
options.description: source lines either side of a hit (default: 1; unused by outline, sym, hover)

options.name: --timeout
options.description: seconds to wait for workspace load (default: 180)

options.name: --no-daemon
options.description: start a dedicated server instead of the shared daemon
